description: Medicare Part D drug coverage from CMS monthly formulary files, current and next plan year: for a drug (name or RxCUI), in one plan, across a state's plans or over every formulary: coverage per strength, cost-share tier, prior authorization, step therapy, quantity limit, IRA negotiated-price flag, 30-day retail/mail cost, plan premium and deductible. Includes the CMS release date. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

drug.description: Drug name (generic or brand, e.g. atorvastatin, Eliquis) or an RxCUI

limit.description: Max plans in a state listing, 1-100 (default 20)

plan.description: Optional plan id CONTRACT-PLAN[-SEGMENT], e.g. H0028-007 or S4802-075

state.description: Optional 2-letter state: list the plans sold there with this drug's coverage

year.description: Plan (contract) year, e.g. 2026 or 2027. Default: the current year if loaded, else the newest

name: health_formulary_coverage_lookup
title: Health Formulary Coverage Lookup
